data.short_meaning: Name of a Companion of the Prophet
data.long_meaning: Hujayrah bint Al-Harith was a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Hujayrah carries the meaning “Name of a Companion of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hujayrah usually hope their child will grow to embody name of a companion of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Compassion, kindness, and generosity are some of the qualities associated with the name Hujayrah.
data.etymology: Hujayrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Name of a Companion of the Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hujayrah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Hujayrah" is derived from the Arabic word "hajar" meaning 'rock', and is associated with the site in Mecca known as the "Hijr Ismailiyyin", which holds historical and cultural significance for Muslims around the world as the birthplace of Prophet Ishmail, the son of Prophet Abraham and Hajar (Hajar being the mother of Ishmail). The name Hujayrah serves as a reminder of the strong bond between the Prophets and their devotion to God, as well as the pivotal role of Hajar in Islamic history.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, Hujayrah is remembered as a symbol of perseverance, sacrifice, and devotion. As the wife of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) and the mother of Ishmail, she displayed unwavering commitment to God by following His commands without question, even when faced with hardships, such as having to leave her husband and infant son in the desert to fulfill God's promise. Her unwavering faith and submission to God continues to inspire and influence the spiritual lives of Muslims, encouraging them to remain steadfast in their faith and trust in God's ultimate plan for them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Name of a Companion of the Prophet" symbolizes Hujayrah bint Al-Harith was a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Hujayrah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of name of a companion of the prophet.
